name: io.github.DMontgomery40/mcp-3d-printer-server
title: MCP 3D Printer Server
description: Control 3D printers, edit STL/3MF models, slice files, and connect Blender through MCP.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Printer backend: octoprint, klipper, duet, repetier, bambu, prusa, or creality.

environmentVariables.name: API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for printer backends that require authentication.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Printer serial number; required for Bambu Lab.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LAN access code; required for Bambu Lab.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Exact Bambu model; required for Bambu print operations.
